rows.headline: Banks in Gujarat closed for Sardar Patel Jayanti
rows.hook: Regional bank holiday observed in Gujarat
rows.summary: Banks in Gujarat are closed today, October 31, to mark Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's birth anniversary, also known as Rashtriya Ekta Diwas. While the date falls on a Thursday, the state government has declared a public holiday, leading to the closure of financial institutions. This is a state-specific holiday and does not apply to banks in other parts of India. Retail customers in Gujarat should plan their banking transactions accordingly.
rows.why_it_matters: Banking services in Gujarat are unavailable today.

rows.summary: To address alarming air pollution levels in the National Capital Region during adverse weather, authorities have mandated that government and private offices operate at a maximum of 50% capacity between November 5 and 20. The restriction aims to reduce vehicular emissions and curb particulate matter concentrations during the peak winter pollution window. While this aims to improve air quality, it could temporarily disrupt daily business operations and commercial productivity across the NCR. Indian retail investors with exposure to businesses heavily reliant on on-site NCR operations may face operational slowdowns.

Revenue from operations rose to ₹40,475 crore, supported by an improved subscriber mix and digital service expansion. The company now serves 542 million subscribers, with 300 million users on its 5G network. Average revenue per user (ARPU) reached ₹218.8 during the period.

rows.headline: Foreign currency inflows hide Indian banks' deposit struggles
rows.hook: Deposit growth lags behind credit demand
rows.summary: Indian banks are facing a widening gap between credit growth and deposit mobilization. While Foreign Currency Non-Resident (FCNR) inflows have provided temporary liquidity, they do not represent core retail deposit growth. This structural mismatch forces banks to rely on costlier wholesale funding to meet loan demand. Retail investors should note that this pressure on margins could impact bank profitability in upcoming quarters.
rows.whats_next: RBI monetary policy committee meeting
rows.why_it_matters: Bank margins may compress as funding costs rise
rows.winners_losers: Borrowers gain / Banks hurt

For Indian retail investors, this contraction highlights ongoing headwinds for the domestic aviation sector and can impact airline revenues. rows.summary: According to a World Bank report, India lifted an estimated 496 million people out of poverty between 2011 and 2023. Extreme poverty in the country declined sharply from 27.1% to 2.6%. For Indian retail investors, this structural shift signifies a massive expansion of the domestic consumer base and long-term economic maturation.

rows.hook: Supreme Court clarifies daughters' inheritance rights
rows.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that married daughters have an equal right to inherit their father's self-acquired or ancestral property. This decision reinforces the Hindu Succession Act, ensuring daughters are not excluded from family assets regardless of their marital status. The ruling settles long-standing legal disputes regarding property distribution among siblings. For retail investors, this clarifies succession planning and potential asset distribution within family-owned businesses.
rows.why_it_matters: Simplifies family succession planning and asset ownership for retail investors.

This projection is based on the All India Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers (AICPI-IW) calculation formula. Analysts and employees are watching whether this will be the final dearness allowance hike before the implementation of the 8th Pay Commission recommendations.
